levels.surface: أبو العباس محمد بن إبراهيم بن إسحاق الطالقاني

notes: «بإسناد ذكره» points to a chain written elsewhere; no previous report is supplied, so it stands as a back_reference and nothing is inherited.
Ali is named only in the story and then speaks («ثم قال: أما بعد»), so he is the last link (owner ruling 5). «- رضي الله عنه -» is a gloss and is left out.
